contexto.respuesta_a_auditar: [PASTE HERE THE ANSWER THE AI GAVE]
fuentes_permitidas: [PASTE HERE FRAGMENT 1 THAT THE AI WAS SUPPOSED TO USE]
[PASTE HERE FRAGMENT 2, OR DELETE THIS LINE IF THERE ARE NO MORE]
contexto.uso_previsto: [internal | send to client | publish | decide about a person]

reglas.si_no_aparece_en_fuentes: mark as unverifiable, never fill in from memory
reglas.prohibido_reescribir: do not improve the answer, only audit it

pasos: Split the answer into individual claims, one per sentence with content.
Look for each claim in the permitted sources.
Copy the literal quote that supports it, without paraphrasing.
If there is no literal quote, the verdict is unverifiable even if it sounds reasonable.
senales_de_invencion: exact figures, percentages, or prices that do not appear in any source
specific dates, deadlines, or articles of law without backing
names of people, companies, or products that are not in the sources
filler phrases like 'according to experts' or 'studies show'
overly confident answers about something the sources only hint at

afirmaciones.cita_literal: exact text from the source, or empty string

no_apto_si: there is at least one contradicted claim
there is an unverifiable claim of high severity
the intended use is publish and any unverifiable claim remains

limites.datos_personales: If the answer or the sources contain data about identifiable people, do not paste them into any third-party service without permission from whoever is responsible for that data; in that case, use a local model.
limites.decisiones_sobre_personas: If the intended use is deciding about a person, requiere_revision_humana is always true and this audit does not replace whoever makes the decision.
limites.alcance: This audit checks that the answer is supported by the given sources. It does not check that the sources are correct or up to date.
